user_inputs.comment: Logger1000A with several SH inverters, each forwarded on its own Logger port (502, 503, 506-509), a meter on 504, the Logger itself on 505 (unit 247). Read-only run.
user_inputs.other_pollers: Home Assistant (Modbus YAML package) keeps polling every device through the Logger during this run; it drives live battery control and could not be stopped

connection.verdict: through a communication module (WiNet-S, WiNet-S2 or Logger), which did not name itself
connection.wifi_or_ethernet: not determinable over Modbus. Nothing in the protocol reports it, and a WiNet-S answers identically wired and over WiFi. Use user_inputs.transport, which is what the contributor said.

contention.polled_by: this Home Assistant, held off for the run
contention.block_read_test: run, before the probes, with this entry's polling held off; see block_read_test

block_read_test.client: modbus-connection through Home Assistant's modbus integration -- the integration's own reads, so it fails exactly where the integration fails
